items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: "Oh Jolly Old Wheeler, good chap." I said, "Yeah, when you see him tell him I’m still struggling to make it."

ctx.x: So anyway he was one of those stubby kind of guys, he was a wing commander, and he had to share my dressing room you see? “Oh,” he says, “Old chap, you were in the Air Force, were you?” I said, “Yes.” He said, “What rank were you?” I said, “I was a leading aircraftsman.” And I said, “I was attached to the number 1 radio-controlled fighter command band, eleven group.” “Oh Jolly Old Wheeler, good chap.” I said, “Yeah, when you see him tell him I’m still struggling to make it.”
